sloka: न एनम् दुह्खेन सम्तप्तः प्रत्यवैक्षत राघवम् ।न च एनम् अभिसम्प्रेक्ष्य प्रत्यभाषत दुर्मनाः ॥२-३९-२॥
transliteration: na enam duhkhena samtaptaḥ pratyavaikṣata rāghavam ।na ca enam abhisamprekṣya pratyabhāṣata durmanāḥ ॥2-39-2॥

translations.english: After hearing Rama and beholding him in the robes of an ascetic, Dasaratha and his wives fell unconscious. With his body and mind afflicted with grief, Dasaratha could not look Rama in the face nor could he make a reply.
translations.hindi: पिता जी से बिदा माँग, सीता सहित घमोत्मा श्रीरामचन्द्र ने | शोक से विकल कोसल्या जी को अणामः किया
